title: Albert-Weasker/niubigeo: ask model APIs how a brand shows up
friendlyTitle: NiubiGEO checks how AI models talk about a brand
summary: NiubiGEO is an open-source workbench for brand-visibility and competitor reports. It was the most-starred new AI project on GitHub's daily TypeScript list, with about 1,307 stars today.
friendlySummary: This free project asks model APIs how a brand appears, then saves the answers. It was the most-starred new AI project on GitHub's TypeScript list today.
whyItMatters: You can run it yourself, under Apache-2.0, to record what provider APIs return about a brand and export a monitoring history. It observes those API responses, not the consumer chat apps people actually open. Paid testing services sit outside the open-source tool.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A business can run it to keep a record of what models say, and compare competitors. It checks the API, not the chat app a customer uses. Paid services are separate.
